mechanics.title: Cycling
mechanics.description: Right-click a placed painting with a painting item in hand to cycle motives; crouch + right-click goes back one. Works with modded paintings. Config can blacklist motives (default ignores the "infernalexp" prefix).

commands_and_keybinds: Right-click a painting with a painting item (crouch to reverse).
getting_started: Place a painting, then right-click it with any painting item.
editor_notes: Whether only same-size motives are cycled is not stated in sources; verify.
name: Cycle Paintings
summary: Right-click a placed painting while holding another painting to switch it to the next motive without removing and replacing it. Crouch while doing so to cycle backwards.
